description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart representing categories and subcategories related to “multiple turns of entangled instructions,” with an inner ring showing 3 main groups and an outer ring showing 9 labeled tasks with numeric values. The inner ring has three slices of roughly similar size: “Contradiction Resolution” (reddish-brown), “Context Retrieving” (dark green/teal), and “Context Tracking” (dark blue). The outer ring contains nine slices, each connected by leader lines to labels with values: “Prioritization 100” (light pink), “Personalization 100” (orange-red), “Privacy Protection 111” (red), “Multitasking 160” (green), “Dynamic Instruction 100” (teal), “Memorization 100” (light cyan), “Dynamic Environment 100” (dark blue), “Recursive Reasoning 110” (bright blue), and “Triggering 100” (light blue). No percentages are printed inside slices; instead, the chart uses the numeric labels outside the ring, and there is no separate legend. The slices are separated by white borders, none appear exploded or offset, and the outer slices vary in angular width consistent with the displayed values (with “Multitasking 160” visibly the largest outer segment).
